newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-ESTONIA TO REPLAY MATCH AGAINST SCOTLAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ESTONIA TO REPLAY MATCH AGAINST SCOTLAND.

text.p: Scotland's World Cup match against Estonia is to be replayed, FIFA vice-president Lennart Johansson said on Thursday.
The group four match, which will be staged in Tallinn by March 16, was abandoned when Estonia failed to turn up to the tie on October 9.
FIFA, the world governing body, had provisionally awarded Scotland a 3-0 win for the match which technically took place and was abandoned after three seconds.
But FIFA General Secretary Sepp Blatter said "The decision to replay the match has been taken in a sporting spirit as Estonia had wanted to play the game and did not voluntarily refuse to play.
"The point was that they did not have enough time to reorganise the arrangements after receiving a fax from FIFA at nine o'clock in the morning and this was taken into account by FIFA."
FIFA will decide on November 23 whether any disciplinary action will be taken against Estonia.
